description: MACD as DIRECTION ONLY: block_bearish off vs on. The require_macd size/availability stack and the narrowing veto are retired, so this is the only MACD entry knob left. Cell false is EXH with no MACD at all; true is 'not crossed down'. The veto fails open on a missing reading, so neither cell can reintroduce an availability refusal. READ FIRST: the veto does not check provenance - 39% of readings carry macd_src=alpaca with no age at all and direction is realtime-and-under-30s on only 48% of rows, so the true cell scores a veto that is acting on a stale reading about half the time. That is a property of the live gate, not of the sim; it caps what this grid can settle.
